description: Customers and partners as glyphs with names.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A heading and the names of customers or partners as Lucide glyphs with a name. Axes: layout (grid, row),
  columns (2, 3, 4), item (name, icon only, tile), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";

export type LogoCloudProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  logos: Logo[];
  empty?: string;
  layout?: "grid" | "row";
  cols?: "2" | "3" | "4";
  item?: "name" | "icon" | "tile";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import LogoRibbon from "../blocks/logo-ribbon.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  logos,
  empty = "",
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "4",
  item = "name",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<LogoCloudProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((logos?.length ?? 0) === 0)"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    align="center"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState icon="building-2" :title="empty" />
  </SectionFrame>
  <LogoRibbon v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'row')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :logos="logos"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  />
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    align="center"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Grid
      :cols="
        (cols as string) === '2' ? '2'
        : (cols as string) === '3' ? '2-3'
        : (cols as string) === '4' ? '2-4'
        : '3-6'
      "
      class="gap-4"
      data-slot="items"
    >
      <Group v-for="logo in logos" :key="logo.id"
        gap="2"
        align="center"
        justify="center"
        :class="cn(
          'text-muted-foreground',
          (((item as string) === 'tile') ? 'flex-col rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border' : '')
        )"
        data-slot="item"
      >
        <LucideIcon :name="logo.icon" :size="24" />
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" :class="(((item as string) === 'icon') ? 'sr-only' : '')">
          {{ logo.name }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
